name: Price per sheet vs per board clarification
description: Tests price lookup with a question about pricing units — whether the price is per sheet or per board. The AI should clarify the unit and return the correct price from the hds_prices table.

messages.text: Is the price for white melamine per sheet or per board? And how much is it?

expected_behaviors.description: Reply should contain a price with R prefix
Reply should reference melamine in the product name

forbidden_patterns.description: No tool call debug text in reply

notes: Tests whether the AI can address unit-of-measure questions alongside the price. The response should clarify whether pricing is per sheet/board and provide the actual price from the table.
